title.zh: 可视化图形、源码与展示质量
title.en: Visual diagrams, source and display quality

text.zh: 结构复杂或流程性的内容配套直观的可视化图形，不能只有文字堆砌或仅交付未渲染的图形源码。根据任务选择 Draw.io、Mermaid、Graphviz 或其他合适工具，保留可编辑或可复现来源。最终展示图完成排版，保证实际尺寸下清晰可读，并采用当前项目明确选择的作图规范；源码作为备用交付。
text.en: Pair structurally complex or process-like content with an intuitive visual diagram; do not leave it as a pile of text or deliver only unrendered diagram source. Choose Draw.io, Mermaid, Graphviz or another suitable tool for the task, and keep an editable or reproducible source. The final display figure must be laid out, clearly readable at its actual size, and follow the diagram convention the current project explicitly chose; the source is a backup deliverable.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 内容结构复杂或具有流程性时
trigger.en: When the content is structurally complex or process-like

purpose.zh: 用直观的图形帮助理解，并保留可编辑或可复现的来源
purpose.en: Help understanding with an intuitive diagram and keep an editable or reproducible source

exclude.zh: 结构简单、文字即可说清的内容
exclude.en: Simple content that text alone explains clearly
